Desc.SourceString: 尽管早雾不想承认但确实很可爱的装扮，帽子领结和小熊背包，不过小熊肚子里是什么呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: An outfit that's undeniably adorable… though Sakiri wouldn't admit it. Comes with a hat, bow tie, and teddy bear backpack. But what's inside the bear's belly?

Desc.SourceString: 手工缝制的舒适衣裙，就算安魂曲每天跌跌撞撞，在房东奶奶的手里也能缝补得完好如初。
Desc.LocalizedString: A comfortable handmade dress. Though Lacrimosa stumbles through her days, her landlady grandmother's skilled hands can always restore it to perfect condition.

Desc.SourceString: 在西装样式的基础上更便于行动的装扮，虽然已经离开了前司，但翳还是习惯这样的打扮。
Desc.LocalizedString: A practical outfit inspired by a suit design, modified for easier movement. Although Skia has left her former company, she's still accustomed to dressing this way.

Desc.SourceString: 街头少女的标准穿搭，作为柯林斯家族的老大，领袖的精神样貌是整个家族的风向标。
Desc.LocalizedString: Typical streetwear with a twist of authority. As the boss of the Colucci family, her appearance sets the tone for the entire clan.

Desc.SourceString: 异象管理局收容行动组制服的改良版，考进收容组是薄荷考试运最好的一次。
Desc.LocalizedString: An upgraded Bureau of Anomaly Control Containment Strike Unit uniform. Making it into the CSU was Mint's greatest stroke of luck.

Desc.SourceString: 「特工Z世代-红」的应援T恤，只要穿上就绝对会吸引到同好……应该吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: A support T-shirt for "Agent Gen Z - Red." Just wearing it should definitely attract fellow fans… right?

Desc.SourceString: 可以挡住半张脸的宽大衣领设计，就像是供于躲藏的贝壳，很方便藏起还不够大胆的表情。
Desc.LocalizedString: The wide collar can cover half the face, acting like a protective shell. Perfect for hiding uncertain expressions.

Desc.SourceString: 异象管理局为每一位禁制机动队成员定制的制服，但除了白藏队长外，没有人会穿。
Desc.LocalizedString: Custom uniforms crafted by the Bureau of Anomaly Control for every Enforcement Tactical Division member—yet only Captain Baicang actually wears one.

Desc.SourceString: 合身的机车服，给翅膀留了足够的活动空间。
Desc.LocalizedString: A well-fitted motorcycle jacket that leaves plenty of room for wing movement.

Desc.SourceString: 兼具武装与优雅的穿搭，管家的存在的意义就是完美处理好一切事务，包括守卫安全和准备今天的早餐。
Desc.LocalizedString: An outfit blending combat readiness with elegance. A butler's role: flawlessly handle every task, from security to preparing breakfast.

Desc.SourceString:
残虹如今惯常穿着的服饰，「红字」消逝之后，残虹又将走向何处？
「刹那即永恒。」
Desc.LocalizedString:
Zankou's usual attire. Now that The Scarlet Letter is gone, where will fate lead Zankou next?
"One moment, forever."

Desc.SourceString: 充满风情的贴身衣装，欲望自胸口开出花，请勿直视。
Desc.LocalizedString: An alluring, form-fitting outfit where desire blossoms from the chest. Best not to stare directly.

Desc.SourceString: 干净利落的剪裁样式，很适合日常活动。
Desc.LocalizedString: Clean, sharp tailoring. Perfect for everyday wear.

Desc.SourceString: 干净利落的剪裁样式，很适合日常活动。
Desc.LocalizedString: Clean, sharp tailoring. Perfect for everyday wear.

Desc.SourceString:
据说是某位知名设计师为浔特别定制的衣装，其价值足够再开十家伊波恩。
「名月下，幽兰泣无声，烟渺渺。」
Desc.LocalizedString:
Rumored to be a custom outfit specially designed for Hotori by a famous designer. Its value could open ten more Eibons. 
"Under the bright moon, orchids weep in silence, mist drifts endlessly."

Desc.SourceString: 便于隐匿的暗色衣装，达芙蒂尔每天早上会花一个小时确保每一片衣角都在该在的位置上。
Desc.LocalizedString: Dark clothing designed for concealment. Daffodill spends an hour each morning making sure every piece of fabric is perfectly in place.

Desc.SourceString: 散发着玫瑰香气的礼服，宽大的帽檐下恰好能望进一双眼里。
Desc.LocalizedString: A rose-scented dress with a wide brim, revealing only a hint of the eyes beneath.

Desc.SourceString:
灵可日常穿着的轻便服装，虽然背后的「电视机」有些沉重，但如果把它当成猫包来看就很好理解了。
「哔波——『宠物』小贞，准备出门。」
「都说了是恶灵！恶灵！」
Desc.LocalizedString:
Linko's lightweight everyday outfit. The "TV" on her back is a bit heavy, but it makes more sense if you think of it as a pet carrier.
"Beep-boop. 'Pet' Xiaozhen is ready to go."
"How many times do I have to tell you? I'm an evil spirit! An evil spirit!"

Desc.SourceString: 咻啪样式的滑翔翼，据说被评为异象管理局内部员工最喜爱的滑翔翼涂装第二名。
Desc.LocalizedString: Chuppa-style wingsuit, reportedly the second most beloved wingsuit skin among Bureau of Anomaly Control staff.

Desc.SourceString: Exe专属的滑翔翼涂装。握住这只手，会产生能前往任何世界的错觉。
Desc.LocalizedString: Exclusive Glider Livery for Exe. Hold this hand, and you can almost imagine traveling to any world.

Desc.SourceString: 曳尔沐专属的滑翔翼涂装。由「旧梦终端」变形而成，操作起来非常轻易。
Desc.LocalizedString: Exclusive Glider Livery for Elyms. Formed from the Dreamworn Terminal. Easy to use, too.

Desc.SourceString: 明音凛专属的滑翔翼涂装。在那些迷路的日子里，会有星星相伴前行。
Desc.LocalizedString: Exclusive Glider Livery for Akane Rin. On the days when you lose your way, the stars will remain your guide.

Desc.SourceString: 黑羽专属的滑翔翼涂装。如果你见到一只这样的鸟，说明好运即将来临。
Desc.LocalizedString: Blackbird-exclusive Glider Livery. If you ever spot a bird like this, fortune awaits you.

Desc.SourceString: 墙壁是面包做的，窗户是糖果做的……巧克力饼干飞机乘着棉花糖风，一直飞，一直飞。
Desc.LocalizedString: The walls are made of bread, and the windows of candy… a chocolate-cookie plane sails the cotton-candy wind, flying forevermore.

Desc.SourceString:
灵可专属滑翔翼涂装，超级恐怖的恶灵驾临海特洛的天空，让所有人仰望臣服！
「宠物小贞解锁新技能——载人飞行！」
「信不信我把你丢下去？！」
Desc.LocalizedString:
Linko's exclusive Glider Livery. A terrifying evil spirit has descended upon the skies of Hethereau—look up and bow before its might!
"Pet Xiaozhen has unlocked a new skill: Carrying Passengers!"
"Keep it up and I'll drop you!"

Desc.SourceString: 残虹专属滑翔翼涂装，恰如赤练飞花，残虹未消。
Desc.LocalizedString: Zankou's exclusive Glider Livery. Like crimson petals dancing on the wind, it leaves a scarlet afterglow that refuses to fade.

Desc.SourceString: 伊洛伊专属滑翔翼涂装。好像，似乎，大概，其实只有一只小羊真的在出力。
Desc.LocalizedString: Iroi's exclusive Glider Livery. Apparently—maybe, probably—only one kiddo is doing all the work.

Desc.SourceString: 独属于真红的翅膀，即使飞向太阳也不会融化——它们早已炽烈燃起。
Desc.LocalizedString: Shinku's wings alone would not melt, even if they soared toward the sun—for they had long since been forged in flame.

Desc.SourceString: 卡厄斯专属滑翔翼涂装，主体采用特别定制帆布，牢固耐用，同时具有独特的粗犷美感。
Desc.LocalizedString: Chaos's exclusive glider livery is made from specially customized canvas. Sturdy and durable, it has a distinctive rugged beauty.

Desc.SourceString: 为了让管理局配发的咻啪也能早点下班，安魂曲用自己最钟爱的番茄元素定制了滑翔翼。咻啪开心，安魂曲也开心。这就是所谓的双赢。
Desc.LocalizedString: Glider Skin - Tomato Balloon Description

Desc.SourceString:
由浔设计的滑翔翼涂装，轻盈的纸伞很适合乘风而飞。
「起风了。」
Desc.LocalizedString:
A glider livery designed by Hotori. Its delicate paper umbrella is perfect for riding the wind.
”The wind is rising.”

Desc.SourceString: 由娜娜莉设计的滑翔翼涂装。「我是副手的副手。现在我带着你滑翔，那么你就是副手的副手的副手！哈哈哈！」
Desc.LocalizedString: A glider livery designed by Nanally. "I'm the underboss of the underboss. And since I'm the one gliding with you now, that makes you the underboss of the underboss of the underboss! Hahaha!"

Desc.SourceString: 以巡哨鼠鼠的座驾为原型设计的滑翔翼涂装。「滴嘟滴嘟，空中秩序维持中……话说回来，这是滑翔翼吧？这些轮子是干什么用的？」
Desc.LocalizedString: A glider livery designed after Officer Whisker's vehicle. "Wee-woo, wee-woo! Maintaining order in the skies… Wait, this is a glider, right? What are these wheels even for?"

Desc.SourceString: 以巡哨鼠鼠为原型设计的滑翔翼涂装。鼠鼠强而有力的尾巴，在空中为你保驾护航。
Desc.LocalizedString: A glider livery designed after Officer Whisker. Its powerful tail keeps you safe as you soar through the skies.

SourceLockText.SourceString: 社媒里程碑活动奖励
SourceLockText.LocalizedString: Social Media Milestone Rewards

Desc.SourceString: 以洄天鱼幡为原型设计的滑翔翼涂装，今日天气预报为多云转阴，出门请记得带伞。
Desc.LocalizedString: A glider livery designed after the Skyfish Banner. Today's forecast is cloudy, possibly overcast. Don't forget your umbrella!

SourceLockText.SourceString: 「漫游手札」玩法获得
SourceLockText.LocalizedString: Obtained through Wanderer's Journal

Desc.SourceString: 以诡面筝为原型设计的滑翔翼涂装，将故障风险提高了99%——不要紧张嘛，只是一个玩笑。
Desc.LocalizedString: A glider livery designed after the Ghostly Kite, increasing the risk of malfunction by 99%… Relax, it's just a joke.

SourceText.LocalizedString: Pink Paws Heist - Pink Paws Den

SourceLockText.SourceString: 粉爪大劫案-粉爪猫窝商店获得
SourceLockText.LocalizedString: Obtained from the Pink Paws Heist - Pink Paws Den Shop.

Desc.SourceString: 独属于海月的水母，可以乘着它滑翔。天空也是它的海洋。
Desc.LocalizedString: A jellyfish unique to Aurelia, carrying you as you glide. The sky is its ocean.

SourceLockText.SourceString: 社媒里程碑活动奖励
SourceLockText.LocalizedString: Social Media Milestone Rewards

Desc.SourceString:
Q³节日限定睡衣，很适合和朋友一起听睡前故事。
「女巫有一片南瓜地，里面有会魔法的干干净净的南瓜，和不会魔法的麻麻赖赖的南瓜。」
Desc.LocalizedString:
Q³ holiday limited edition pajamas, perfect for listening to bedtime stories with friends.
"A witch had a pumpkin field with squeaky clean magical pumpkins, and scruffy non-magical pumpkins."

Desc.SourceString:
学院风格服装，兼顾美观与舒适。袖标由娜娜莉自行制作，本人对此颇为满意。
「咳咳，柯林斯有柯林斯的风纪！」
Desc.LocalizedString:
School uniform style clothing that balances both beauty and comfort. The armband was handmade by Nanally herself, and she's quite satisfied with it.
"Ahem, Colucci has its own standards of discipline!"

DyeDesc.SourceString:
学院风格服装，兼顾美观与舒适。袖标由娜娜莉自行制作，本人对此颇为满意。

DyeDesc.LocalizedString:

Desc.SourceString:
一套设计独特的格斗服。娜娜莉为此特地报名了格斗训练班。
「什么时候去上训练课？呃……下次一定！」
Desc.LocalizedString:
A fighting outfit with a unique design. Nanally specifically enrolled in a combat training class for this.
"When am I going to attend the training sessions? Uh… Next time for sure!"

Desc.SourceString: 柯林斯家族的领地已经扩张到了海洋板块，娜娜莉船长已经准备就绪！出发，为了家族！
Desc.LocalizedString: The Coluccis are expanding into open waters, and Captain Nanally is ready to set sail! All aboard, for the family!

Desc.SourceString:
娜娜莉的居家服装。在简单衣裙的基础上添加了富有巧思的装饰。
「正所谓如虎添翼，老虎和翅膀就是绝配！」
Desc.LocalizedString:
Nanally's loungewear. Thoughtful decorations have been added to a simple dress.
"Ever heard of 'adding wings to a tiger'? Tigers and wings are a perfect combo!"

SourceLockText.SourceString: 羁遇等级达到10级获得
SourceLockText.LocalizedString: Available at Bond Lvl 10

Desc.SourceString:
Q³节日限定睡衣，很适合和朋友一起听睡前故事。
「从前在森林里有一只孤单的小灰狼，为了交到朋友，它带上了丝绒做的红斗篷。」
Desc.LocalizedString:
Q³ holiday limited edition pajamas, perfect for listening to bedtime stories with friends.
"Once upon a time, there was a lonely little gray wolf in the forest who donned a velvet red cape, hoping to make friends."

Desc.SourceString: 亮闪闪的玻璃糖纸会被阳光照出彩虹的颜色，而这一颗，是薄荷口味。
Desc.LocalizedString: A shiny candy wrapper catches the sunlight and shimmers with every color of the rainbow. This one's mint.

DyeDesc.SourceString: 亮闪闪的玻璃糖纸会被阳光照出彩虹的颜色，而这一颗，是薄荷口味。
DyeDesc.LocalizedString: A shiny candy wrapper catches the sunlight and shimmers with every color of the rainbow. This one's mint.

Desc.SourceString:
薄荷的居家服装。简单的服饰，彰显居家的随性与放松。
「休息日，当然要宅在家里睡大觉！」
Desc.LocalizedString:
Mint's loungewear. Simple clothing that showcases the carefree and relaxed spirit of being a homebody.
"There's nothing better than staying home and sleeping in on a day off!"

Q³节日限定睡衣，很适合和朋友一起听睡前故事。
「玛丽有只小黑猫，耳朵是母亲的，身体是父亲的，兄弟姐妹是它的四肢，无论玛丽走到哪里，它总是跟着跑。」
Desc.LocalizedString:
Q³ holiday limited edition pajamas, perfect for listening to bedtime stories with friends.
"Mary had a little black cat, with ears from her mother, a body from her father, and siblings as its limbs. Wherever Mary went, it would always follow along."

Desc.SourceString:
九原的居家服装。看似简单的衣装，也经由设计师精心设计。
「吸气……呼气……舒展身体，让心情平静……」
Desc.LocalizedString:
Jiuyuan's loungewear. Though it looks simple, this outfit was carefully tailored by a designer.
"Breathe in… breathe out… stretch your body, let your mind find peace…"

SourceLockText.SourceString: 羁遇等级达到10级获得
SourceLockText.LocalizedString: Available at Bond Lvl 10

Desc.SourceString:
俏皮又不失帅气的着装，层叠的衣衫和亮眼的配饰，尽显随性自由。
「一流的猎人，也该有一流的衣品~」
Desc.LocalizedString:
Playful yet stylish attire with layers and eye-catching accessories, showcasing a carefree personality.
"A first-rate hunter should have first-rate fashion sense too!"

Desc.LocalizedString: Light and fitted, clean and sharp styling that never goes wrong, helping you blend into crowds with ease.

Desc.SourceString: 「粉爪银行」改良版员工制服，配色很符合「粉爪」的基调，小吱每天早上至少会花上一个小时来确保自己的衣装干净整洁。
Desc.LocalizedString: An updated Pink Paws Bank employee uniform, redesigned to match the brand's signature color scheme. Chiz spends at least an hour every morning ensuring her outfit is spotless and perfectly pressed.

Desc.SourceString:
以鬼兰花为主题的高级定制套装，这套在影楼非常容易出效果。
不过从价格角度来考虑的话，大概只有在伊波恩开店前、资金还充裕的那时候才有商量余地。
Desc.LocalizedString: A custom couture outfit themed after the Ghost Orchid, purchased when Hotori still had plenty of startup funds after opening her shop.As for later… even after selling her car, she never once considered parting with this piece. She must really love it.

Desc.SourceString:
浔的居家服装。宽松轻便的打扮，躲闲时还是舒服最重要。
「惊鹿一声响。」
Desc.LocalizedString:
Hotori's loungewear. Comfortable and lightweight—when lying around the house, comfort is paramount.
"Soft birdsong in the morning."

SourceLockText.LocalizedString: Available at Bond Lvl 10

Desc.SourceString: 轻便舒适的衣装，穿在身上，耳畔仿佛回荡着浪花漫卷沙滩的声音。
Desc.LocalizedString: A loose outfit with emphasis on breathable fabric—when wearing it, it's almost as if you can hear the gentle rolling of waves.

Desc.SourceString:
小吱的居家服装。柔软亲肤的面料，休假时间就该舒舒服服地待在家里啊。
「虽然明天也不出门，但请……请出太阳吧！」
Desc.LocalizedString:
Chiz's loungewear. Soft, skin-friendly material—staying at home is the right way to spend a day off.
"I'm not going out tomorrow either, but… I hope the sun still comes out!"

SourceLockText.SourceString: 羁遇等级达到10级获得
SourceLockText.LocalizedString: Available at Bond Lvl 10

Desc.SourceString: 浔自费购入的衣装，用以改善小水仙沉闷的衣柜，达芙蒂尔为此新买了五个不同的眼罩用来搭配它。
Desc.LocalizedString: Hotori personally purchased this outfit to brighten up Daff's rather dull wardrobe. In response, Daffodill bought five different eye patches just to match it.

Desc.SourceString: 便于隐匿的暗色衣装，达芙蒂尔每天早上会花一个小时确保每一片衣角都在该在的位置上。
Desc.LocalizedString: Dark clothing designed for concealment. Daffodill spends an hour each morning making sure every piece of fabric is perfectly in place.

Desc.SourceString:
粉爪银行某年年会的表演着装，彼时的乔望尼先生正异常沉迷这种黑白色生物。
「我、我们银行是要和胖达火锅联名吗……」
Desc.LocalizedString:
Performance outfit from Pink Paws Bank's annual annual gala. At the time, Mr. Giovanni had developed an unusual fascination with a particular black-and-white animal 
"Are we… are we partnering with Panda Hotpot now?"

Desc.SourceString:
颓废华丽的盛装，适合在出席古堡晚宴时穿着。
「夜空倾覆而下，浸透庭园里的玫瑰。多年之后，她们仍静默地绽放，而故事的后文终究无人知晓。」
Desc.LocalizedString:
A decadent, ornate formal dress, perfect for a castle banquet.
"The night sky poured over the garden, soaking its roses in muted darkness. Years later, those flowers still bloom in silence, and the rest of the story has faded into shadow."

Desc.SourceString:
就像夜与昼一样，这世上黑白分明的东西有很多：浓缩咖啡与拿铁咖啡，奶牛猫与牛奶猫，钢琴的黑键与白键，日常打扮的安魂曲和偶尔换上白裙子出门的安魂曲。
「白裙子，很好看。但是，容易弄脏……」
Desc.LocalizedString:
Like night and day, some things in this world are simply black and white: espresso and latte, tuxedo cats and white cats, piano keys, Lacrimosa's everyday outfit, and the white dress she wears only once in a while.
"White dresses are pretty. But… they get dirty so easily."

Desc.SourceString: 闪耀之物往往很沉重。今天上班路上总觉得比往日飞得更累，或许不是安魂曲的错觉。
Desc.LocalizedString: Things that shine are often heavy. Lacrimosa feels unusually tired flying to work today. Maybe it isn't just her imagination.

Desc.SourceString:
安魂曲的居家服装。布料柔软舒适，支持随时随地倒头就睡。
「一只蝙蝠……两只蝙蝠……三……呼……」
Desc.LocalizedString:
Lacrimosa's loungewear. Made of soft, cozy fabric that lets you fall asleep anytime, anywhere.
"One bat… two bats… three… zzz…"

SourceLockText.LocalizedString: Available at Bond Lvl 10

Desc.SourceString: 幸福的降临或许总是毫无章法，宛如一场横冲直撞的「硬着陆」。就像昭示幸福来临的蝙蝠飞入窗棂时，也总伴着清脆的巨响和散落一地的碎玻璃那样。
Desc.LocalizedString: Happiness sometimes arrives without rhyme or reason, like a reckless hard landing. Just as the bat that foretells good fortune flies through the window lattice, it always comes with a crisp crash and shattered glass strewn across the floor.

Desc.SourceString: 暗色的衣装隐于黑夜。
Desc.LocalizedString: Dark attire cloaked in night.

DyeDesc.SourceString: 暗色的衣装隐于黑夜。
DyeDesc.LocalizedString: Dark attire cloaked in night.

Desc.SourceString: 于海浪间穿梭的黑色身影，或许也能找到独属于他的新航线，至于航线的终点会是什么……管他呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: A dark figure races across the waves, carving out a route of his own. Where does it lead? Eh, he'll figure it out.

Desc.SourceString: 即使是休息日，也不能松懈锻炼！
Desc.LocalizedString: Even on days off, training never stops!

Desc.SourceString: 休闲街头风格着装，简易单品与独特的配饰碰撞，亦能彰显个性。
Desc.LocalizedString: A casual streetwear look that pairs simple pieces with bold accessories to express true individuality.

Desc.SourceString:
虽然真红一向不太在意，但这套穿搭大概只适合出现在仲夏时节。
「……活动起来很方便，有问题吗？」
Desc.LocalizedString:
Shinku rarely concerns herself with what she wears, but this outfit suits midsummer perfectly.
"…It's easy to move in. Is there a problem?"

Desc.SourceString: 万千风暴向心口收束，猎龙之人将踏上她的征途。
Desc.LocalizedString: Countless storms gather in her heart, and the dragonhunter sets forth on her quest.

Desc.SourceString:
"昭示着好胜心的专业竞赛泳装。海滨似乎总有让人变得坦率的魔力，又或者在水中破开浪潮的畅快感也推了一把。
「在享受夏日这件事上也要全力以赴。」"
Desc.LocalizedString:
A pro-grade racing swimsuit that reveals her competitive spirit. The beach has a way of drawing out one's true self—or perhaps that is simply the thrill of cutting through the waves.
"Go all out—even when you’re enjoying summer."

Desc.SourceString:
让人联想到青春感的学院风穿搭。据说每个人在这段时期都会逃避和追逐阴影中的那个自己……即使没有也会想办法找一个出来。
「不要随便用这种蠢透了的方式来解读……唉，算了。」
Desc.LocalizedString:
A neat, preppy outfit with the fresh charm of campus life. They say youth is spent either fleeing from one's inner shadow or chasing after it… and even those without a shadow will find a way to cast one.
"Don't read something that ridiculous into it… Ugh, whatever."

Desc.SourceString:

「……不行。今天已经决定了，无论如何都不出门。」
Desc.LocalizedString:
Shinku's loungewear for quiet days spent idling undisturbed among her treasures. Once a dragon has made up her mind, no force can shake her resolve.
"…No. I've already decided. I'm not going out today, no matter what."

「绕一点远路，说不定就会多一点惊喜哦。」
Desc.LocalizedString:
Linko's school-inspired outfit. A crisp uniform, a spring in her step, and a route that never quite goes as planned.
"Take the scenic route. You might find a surprise or two."

Desc.SourceString:
灵可的奇思妙想总是没有边界，自从淘到这套时装之后，她就总在想自己有没有可能能接收到世界以外的电波。
她的背包里装着一座小小花园，也装着继续前行的勇气。植物会长大，旅途也是。
Desc.LocalizedString:
Linko's imagination knows no limits. Ever since she found this outfit, she's wondered whether she can tune in to signals from beyond this world.
Her backpack holds a tiny garden and the courage to keep going. Plants grow, and so does the journey.

A school uniform straight out of Neverland, where fairies live—a little touch of storybook magic.
"Winter's over, and spring is here! Why not head out and enjoy it with your best friend?"

Desc.SourceString:
去朋友家串门时穿的，清爽而舒适的休闲装扮。
戴上眼镜时整体印象会迷幻般地变调，感觉要开始讲课……或者是讲述一段新的、人与人的故事了。
Desc.LocalizedString:
A fresh, comfortable casual outfit for dropping by a friend's place.
Add the glasses, and there's something almost dreamlike about the look—as though they're about to give a lecture… or tell another story about how people connect.

Desc.SourceString:
挎包和大衣中存储着各类轻量化的电子信息战设备，当然，加在一起的分量一点也不轻。
在管理局室内工作的时候也总是穿着这么沉重的一套……到底在和什么打仗呢？
Desc.LocalizedString:
His crossbody bag and coat are stuffed with all kinds of lightweight electronic warfare gear. Each piece is light enough on its own, but together? Not so much.
He even wears all that gear while working indoors at the Bureau… What exactly is he fighting?

Desc.SourceString:
秋冬季在室外需要多披上一件风衣，莫名很适合搭配一杯热咖啡的印象。
那条围巾轻盈而柔软地缠绕住脖颈，不可思议的是比看起来更加保暖。
Desc.LocalizedString:
In fall and winter, a trench coat is the perfect extra layer for heading outdoors. Somehow, it just seems to go with a hot cup of coffee.
The scarf feels soft and light around your neck, yet keeps you surprisingly warm.

Desc.SourceString:
特别的户外防水服饰，可能会导致被判定为雨夜的杀人鬼或死神一类的角色。
——洗刷不去的颜色所代表的是，绝不容许消逝的一切瞬间。
Desc.LocalizedString:
An eye-catching waterproof outfit that could get you mistaken for a killer on a rainy night—or even the Grim Reaper.
—Colors that won't wash away, for moments we refuse to let fade.

Desc.SourceString:
对于极少放假的工作狂来说，这是极低概率才会出现的穿着。
为什么会有人在不用上班的休息时间……反而看起来心情更差的样子？
Desc.LocalizedString:
A rare sight: a workaholic finally taking a day off.
So why do they look even more miserable when they don't have to work…?
